title: Meeting With The True One, Fear Departs
summary: Ego is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart; o mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs
lifeApplication: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.shortMeaning: It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart; o mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs
source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.

evidence.coreClaim: It all worked out-I was saved, and the egotism within my heart; o mind, meeting with the True One, fear departs
evidence.turn: Ego steadies when o Nanak, one who stocks this True Merchandise shall recognize and realize the Genuine.
